1479-2443-2841-8293.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Evolving Wilds.
1479-2443-2841-8293.description:
Fetch a land using Evolving Wilds.
When the fetched land enters, Cleveland Booker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Cleveland Booker trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Cleveland Booker triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

222-527-6791-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-6791-8249.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Defiant Salvager twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2577-5670-6772.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2577-5670-6772.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Syr Vondam triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1661-5078-5434-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Myth Unbound

708-728-1469-2459.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Court of Vantress trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from Myth Unbound and Court of Vantress.
Repeat.

46-223.manaNeeded: {2}{U} plus the cost of the additional sorcery
46-223.notablePrerequisites: You have an additional castable sorcery.
46-223.description:
Cast any sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Cooperate by paying its mana cost.
Kalamax's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first ability, creating a copy of Cooperate and choosing to copy the original Cooperate.
Resolve the second ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kalamax.
Resolve the Cooperate copy, creating a copy of Cooperate.
Kalamax's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 6 any number of times.

129-1409-4359-6723.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

215-1526-4885.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
215-1526-4885.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Circle of Dreams Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Circle of Dreams Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1619-2921-4605-5542-6150.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2921-4605-5542-6150.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Tomb of Horrors Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Tomb of Horrors Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Tomb of Horrors Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Tomb of Horrors Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Tomb of Horrors Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2921-4605-5542-6150.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

240-5256-5929.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Leyline of Transformation, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-5256-5929.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

372-864-7339.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Go Ninja Go exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-864-7339.description:
Cast Go Ninja Go by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Eternal Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Eternal Witness trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Go Ninja Go from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Go Ninja Go.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Eternal Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4552-6705-7290.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Does Machines.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1233-1879-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1233-1879-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Squee as attackers.
Squee triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-3817-4200.description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Icewind Stalwart.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart ability, blinking Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Icewind Stalwart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2341-2495-3053.easyPrerequisites: There are at least two basic land types among lands you control
2341-2495-3053.description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Prismatic Geoscope and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Prismatic Geoscope by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Prismatic Geoscope and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Prismatic Geoscope and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

11-2575-2928-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-2575-2928-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Temporal Mastery by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Temporal Mastery.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Temporal Mastery spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Temporal Mastery spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Temporal Mastery and returning the original Temporal Mastery to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Temporal Mastery from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

1563-3490-5295-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1563-3490-5295-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

4396-5344-6349.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell from anywhere but your hand this turn.
4396-5344-6349.description:
Cast Charismatic Conqueror from the top of your library by paying {1}{W}.
Charismatic Conqueror's demonstrate ability triggers, causing you and an opponent to copy it.
Resolve the opponent's copy of Charismatic Conqueror, and then resolve your copy of Charismatic Conqueror.
When your Charismatic Conqueror token enters the battlefield,  the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to tap your Charismatic Conqueror token.
Resolve the original Charismatic Conqueror spell.
When the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the opponent's Vampire token enters the battlefield, both Charismatic Conquerors you control trigger, causing you to create at least one 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When your Vampire token enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the Vampire token, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Repeat from step 7.

856-5220-6798-6900.manaNeeded: {B} if Cauldron Familiar is in your hand
856-5220-6798-6900.easyPrerequisites: You have a life total of at least 2 if Cauldron Familiar is on top of your library.
856-5220-6798-6900.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {B} or 1 life respectively.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

671-2034-3000-4593.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Daxos triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the creature tokens die, Daxos triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.
671-2034-3000-4593.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

1020-1796-3689-6518.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

141-2921-6475.description:
Cast Reunion of the House by paying {5}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reunion of the House.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Reunion of the House, targeting Naru Meha and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Reunion of the House, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

465-969-3742-4251-4452.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-969-3742-4251-4452.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

586-5231-5258-5618.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Priest of Gix, adding {R}.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

777-3532-5078-5240.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Oneirophage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1409-1889-2060.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Simian Simulacrum.
1409-1889-2060.description:
Activate Simian Simulacrum by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Simian Simulacrum enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Simian Simulacrum trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Simian Simulacrum.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1365-4853-5296.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, Workhorse gain persist until end of turn.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter, adding {C}.
Repeat from step 2 until Workhorse dies.
Dross Scorpion and Workhorse triggers.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Workhorse persist ability trigger, returning it to the battlefield with three +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1170-2456-3518.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Tezzeret.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Tezzeret's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
